title: AI Peer Review per-repo config
description: Drop this file at .github/ai-peer-review.json in a consuming repo to tailor classification, reviewer rosters, and ceilings. Every field is optional; omitted fields use safe defaults. Unknown keys are ignored (forward compatible). Wrong types fail the run loudly so a bad config can never silently misclassify.

project_name.description: Human-readable project name used in comments/emails.

operator_github_login.description: GitHub login of the human operator who can issue OPERATOR commands and receives escalations.

high_stakes_paths.description: fnmatch globs. Any changed file matching these forces the high_stakes tier (strictest review + escalation). Unknown paths already default to high_stakes (deny-first); list the files most dangerous to change.

content_scan_safety_tokens.description: Literal substrings; if any appears in the diff, the PR is high_stakes regardless of path.

content_scan_safety_patterns.description: Python regexes; if any matches the diff, the PR is high_stakes regardless of path.

routine_root_exact.description: Exact root-level filenames treated as routine (docs/config), e.g. README.md.

routine_root_globs.description: Root-level-only globs treated as routine, e.g. *.md (does NOT match nested markdown).

backend_path_roots.description: Path prefixes considered backend code (not safety-relevant), e.g. src/, tests/.

routine_reviewers.description: Reviewer roster for the routine tier.

backend_reviewers.description: Reviewer roster for the backend tier.

high_stakes_reviewers.description: Reviewer roster for the high_stakes tier.

max_review_rounds.description: Hard cap on review rounds before forced escalation.

per_pr_cost_ceiling_usd.description: Per-PR spend ceiling; exceeding it escalates instead of spending more.

daily_cost_ceiling_usd.description: Rolling 24h spend ceiling across the repo.
